ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota Daycare Fraud Probe
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Minnesota daycare fraud probe and the potential for similar fraud in other states.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the potential for widespread fraud
questions: What is the extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
Are similar programs in other states vulnerable to similar scams?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and to identify potential solutions to prevent similar scams in the future.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Gateway Tunnel Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the Gateway Tunnel funding freeze on the region's transportation infrastructure and economy.
ideas.angle: Investigate the potential consequences of the funding freeze
questions: What are the potential consequences of the funding freeze?
How will the region's transportation infrastructure be affected?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to provide insight into the potential consequences of the funding freeze and to identify potential solutions to mitigate the impact.
